brand_name.font: Cabinet Grotesk or similar Wide Geometric Sans

owner_name.font: Playfair Display, Cormorant Garamond, or similar elegant Serif

layouts.splash_screen: Flex-1, absolute centering for main brand, bottom-anchored alignment for the owner name. Avoid center-everything disease: balance the heavy center logo with a delicate, wide-spaced owner name at the bottom, padded by 48px from the bottom safe area.

motion.entry: 1200ms ease-out fade in for background and logo.
motion.stagger: Owner name 'Akash Choyal' fades in 400ms AFTER the logo, with a subtle upward translation (e.g., +10px to 0px).

SplashScreen.description: The initial launch screen bridging the native splash to the JS thread.
SplashScreen.structure: View (Container) -> View (Center: Logo/Brand) -> View (Bottom: 'From' or 'Founder' label + Owner Name)
SplashScreen.styling: Background color #0A1F16. The exact name 'Akash Choyal' MUST be explicitly displayed at the bottom.

accessibility.guidelines: Ensure the owner name has sufficient contrast against the deep green background (APCA/WCAG compliant).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this. Make the splash screen feel like a cinematic opening scene. Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. DO NOT use generic centered layouts without establishing vertical tension. Always include `data-testid` on all key elements. DO NOT modify files unless creating the splash screen as instructed. This is a React Native Expo environment, so translate these design concepts into StyleSheet or NativeWind classes appropriately.
instructions_to_main_agent: Create a custom Splash Screen component in the React Native Expo app. The screen must display the KrishiAI branding and prominently feature the exact name 'Akash Choyal' near the bottom, signifying ownership/founder. Implement a brief delay/animation before navigating to the authentication or main app, preserving session restoration logic.
